doc.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Jokes about age and getting up early, thanks, and an invitation to visit Hamilton College.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Fascinating. You’ve given me some things to think about for the whole rest of the day.
Well that’s why I’m older than you.
Well I liked your philosophy about wanting to see as much sunlight as you could and that’s why you get up so early every morning.
Listen, if I’m home usually I pick up the paper and look at the obituaries, and if I don’t see my name, I get up and go do something.
All right. Well, Keter Betts, it’s been a real pleasure having you join Hamilton College.
I hope the rest of your weekend goes very well.
And I would like sometime in the near future, if possible, if you have anything musically up that way, you know, even talks or whatever, to come up there.
We’re planning on it actually, we’re planning some things, and I’d love to have you.
Is that a threat or a promise?
That is a promise. And when you get there it might turn out to be a threat, I don’t know. Thanks so much.
